productTitle: M001 EVA Closed Toe Slip-On Mules with Raised Footbed Nodes and Open Heel for Casual Wear Wholesale
textDesc:
Easy slip-on entry: The open heel lets the foot slide in from the back, while the closed toe covers the forefoot.

Soft EVA upper: The moulded EVA body provides soft coverage around the foot, with ribbed sidewalls and a textured front panel.

Textured underfoot feel: Individual raised footbed nodes form distinct contact points beneath the foot.
